visual_description: Premium TechBody studio entrance with dark charcoal walls, soft orange accent lighting, white signage, high-contrast editorial illumination and defined cinematic shadows; a client enters with calm confidence.
voiceover: Tudo começa num estúdio preparado para uma experiência diferente.
camera_movement: Smooth forward tracking shot through the entrance, ending with a subtle push-in toward the training area.

visual_description: Detailed close-ups of the client putting on the EMS suit while a trainer adjusts the electrodes; premium medical-certified equipment manufactured in Germany, dark charcoal background, soft orange highlights, crisp white details and dramatic shadows.
voiceover: O fato EMS é ajustado ao corpo com equipamento certificado médico, fabricado na Alemanha.
camera_movement: Fast cinematic macro cuts across fabric, electrodes and fastening points, followed by a controlled side slide.

visual_description: The trainer calmly explains the session while the client adopts a stable exercise position; the EMS control system is visible, with premium studio lighting, dark charcoal surfaces, soft orange accents and strong editorial contrast.
voiceover: Com orientação próxima, cada posição e intensidade são ajustadas antes de começar.
camera_movement: Over-the-shoulder shot toward the control system, then a slow arc around the client into the starting position.

visual_description: Peak WB-EMS training moment: the client performs a controlled squat as impulses activate, with visible full-body muscular tension and simultaneous engagement of multiple muscle groups; high-contrast studio lighting, soft orange rim light and defined shadows.
voiceover: Os impulsos ativam vários grupos musculares em simultâneo, com baixo impacto articular.
camera_movement: Dynamic low-angle orbit around the squat, intercut with tight shots of controlled muscle contraction and the EMS indicators.

visual_description: The session ends and the client stands upright, breathing steadily with a satisfied expression and a clear sense of having completed a full workout; premium TechBody studio, dark charcoal palette, soft orange light and clean white highlights.
voiceover: Em cerca de 20 a 25 minutos, fica a sensação de um treino completo.
camera_movement: Slow pull-back from a close portrait to reveal the full studio, with a gentle rise for a composed finish.

visual_description: Minimal premium end frame with the TechBody identity on a dark charcoal background, soft orange accent line, white typography, high contrast and defined editorial shadows; the client and trainer appear subtly in the background.
voiceover: Descobre a experiência TechBody. Marca a tua sessão experimental.
camera_movement: Subtle cinematic push-in toward the centered call to action, ending on a perfectly still brand frame.
